# Calm Joints

> Calm Joints (Calm Joints Inc.) is a virtual physiotherapy service in Canada. People book registered physiotherapists online. Managed Physio is online physio Scale runs for a partner's customers or employees. They book on the Calm Joints site. Digital care first; in person only if needed. Canada-wide now. USA planned Q1 2027. Partners share the revenue.

## Enterprise: one click to physio
- [Managed Physio. One click to physio.](https://calmjoints.org/enterprise): Scale runs online physio for a partner's customers or employees. They book on the Calm Joints site. Setup is agreed with the partner. Canada-wide now. USA planned Q1 2027. Optional turnkey co-branded store.
- Contact: info@calmjoints.org or the form at https://calmjoints.org/enterprise#talk

## For people
- [Home](https://calmjoints.org/): Book virtual physio with a registered physiotherapist.
- [Talk to a guide](https://calmjoints.org/chat): Virtual recovery guides (not clinicians).
- [Blog](https://calmjoints.org/blog): Recovery articles.

## Racquets
- [Racquets index](https://calmjoints.org/racquets): Squash, tennis, pickleball, padel and badminton recovery pages.
- [Squash](https://calmjoints.org/squash): Between-match squash kit and video physio assessment.
- [Tennis](https://calmjoints.org/tennis): Between-match tennis kit and video physio assessment.
- [Pickleball](https://calmjoints.org/pickleball): Between-game pickleball kit and video physio assessment.
- [Padel](https://calmjoints.org/paddle): Enclosed-court padel kit and video physio assessment.
- [Badminton](https://calmjoints.org/badminton): Between-match badminton kit and video physio assessment.

## Club partnerships (squash, tennis, pickleball)
- Private athletic and racquet clubs can partner with Calm Joints from https://calmjoints.org/squash#club-partner, https://calmjoints.org/tennis#club-partner or https://calmjoints.org/pickleball#club-partner.
- Tier 1, physio only: the club displays a co-branded QR code (a 24 x 36 in stand-up sign at court side, or a compact sign on a wall, the court glass or a fence). Anyone who books through it gets sessions with registered therapists across the province, and the club earns a 25% payout on net revenue from those bookings.
- Tier 2, full recovery activation: a co-branded member store at wholesale rates, with physiotherapy built in.
- Hands-off for club staff. Request either tier with the form on those pages. The opportunity calculator at https://calmjoints.org/enterprise#estimate is illustrative only, not a payout guarantee.

## Partners
- [Partnerships](https://calmjoints.org/partners): Hubs and partnerships for gyms, studios, brands, employers and clinics.
- [Careers](https://calmjoints.org/careers): Roles for physiotherapists.

## Notes
- Calm Joints is not a medical device and not emergency care. In an emergency, call 911.
